{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")
print(f"Proportion of -1 values: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).mean():.2%}")

# Check revenue column for string format
print(f"First few revenue values: {sales['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {(sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check channel distribution
print(f"Channel distribution:\n{sales['channel'].value_counts()}")

# Check customer_segment distribution
print(f"Customer segment distribution:\n{sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()}")

# Check if channel and customer_segment are confounded
print(f"Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n{pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment'])}")"}
